title: S9 F.15 — Performance test: 200-row batch < 5s; 10K-card filter < 100ms p95
description: Per spec §H.3 + §A.3 + §E.3, validates the architectural performance budgets: a 200-row batch (the configured per-tick batch size per source) completes in under 5 seconds on dev hardware (enabling backlog burndown), and a filter query against a 10K-card account completes in under 100ms p95.
design: Add test/performance/beads_poller_perf_test.rb (or place under test/integration with a perf tag). Scenario A: seed 200 Beads events spanning issues/labels/comments → run a single poller tick → assert tick wall-clock duration < 5000ms. Scenario B: seed an account with 10K Cards + matching tags/assignments → run each filter operator (status:, tag:, assignee:, created:>) 100 times → assert p95 latency < 100ms. Skip in normal CI; run via PERF=1 bin/rails test test/performance/beads_poller_perf_test.rb.
acceptance_criteria: PERF=1 bin/rails test test/performance/beads_poller_perf_test.rb passes both scenarios on the developer machine. Output reports observed wall-clock + p95 latencies for review.

title: S9 F.14 — Replay/idempotency tests: same Beads row twice → no duplicate side effects
description: Per spec §B.1 + §G.1, every mirror procedure is idempotent on the same Beads row. A poller restart that replays already-processed rows must produce zero new mirror rows and zero new side effects (jobs, notifications, webhook dispatches).
design: Add test/integration/beads_poller_replay_test.rb. For each procedure (issue, label, comment, event), seed the Beads source row, run a poller tick, capture the mirror state + enqueued job count, then run a second tick (simulating a crash/restart replay) and assert state is unchanged AND no new jobs were enqueued. Specifically: (a) same Beads event_id → no duplicate Event row (S8 §B.2 unique index), (b) same Beads comment id → no duplicate Comment / ActionText / Search::Record / Mention::CreateJob, (c) processed_ids overlap window catches same-second replays.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/integration/beads_poller_replay_test.rb passes; for each procedure the second tick produces 0 new mirror rows and 0 new ActiveJob enqueues (assert_no_enqueued_jobs around the second tick).

title: S9 F.13 — Integration tests: end-to-end poller tick (Beads row → MySQL + side effects)
description: Per spec §H.2, end-to-end coverage proving the full pipeline: a Beads SQL row appears, the poller tick processes it, and the MySQL mirror row + Search::Record + side-effect jobs (Notifiable, WebhookDispatchJob, Mention::CreateJob) all materialize correctly.
design: Add test/integration/beads_poller_test.rb. Scenarios: (1) seed a Beads issues row → tick → assert Card mirror row + Search::Record exist; (2) seed a Beads events row of label_added type → tick → assert Tag + Tagging + Event mirror rows exist; (3) seed a Beads comments row → tick → assert Comment + ActionText::RichText + Search::Record + watch row + Mention::CreateJob enqueue + comment_created Event + WebhookDispatchJob enqueue. Use Account.singleton + SystemActor as the Current context.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/integration/beads_poller_test.rb passes all three scenarios; assertions verify both row presence and job enqueueing via assert_enqueued_with.

title: S9 F.12 — Search::Record content sourcing audit: verify upsert! is invoked for every cards/comments mirror
description: Per spec §F.2 + §B.2, since mirror procedures are callback-bypass, Search::Record.upsert! MUST be explicitly invoked after every cards / comments mirror write. This audit ensures no shard row drifts from its source.
design: Add test coverage and code paths confirming Search::Record.upsert! is called from Beads::Mirror::Issue.call (Card content = title + beads_status + tag titles) and from Beads::Mirror::Comment.call (Comment content = body plaintext truncated to Searchable::SEARCH_CONTENT_LIMIT). Verify shard routing via CRC32(account_id) % 16 still produces the correct shard table. The 16-shard FTS pattern (Search::Record.search) is preserved unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/search/record_test.rb passes: (a) mirror_issue produces a Search::Record row with content matching the mirrored card fields, (b) mirror_comment produces a Search::Record row with content matching the comment plaintext, (c) shard table is determined by CRC32(account_id) % 16, (d) Search::Record.search returns the freshly mirrored content within one tick.

title: S9 F.11 — Filter compiler audit: ensure all filter operators emit Card mirror SQL only (no :beads joins)
description: Per spec §E.1 + §E.2 (and Gemini S2 prior #1), the Filter compiler must NEVER emit cross-DB joins. All filter operators must compile to MySQL against cards / cards.beads_status / taggings JOIN tags / assignments / comments only — no :beads connection access.
design: Audit app/models/filter.rb + app/models/filter/translator.rb (or successor; verify path). For every supported operator (status:, tag:, assignee:, created:, closed:, text:), confirm the emitted SQL targets the substrate enumerated in §E.1. Add a test guard: a translator unit test that asserts ActiveRecord::Base.connection (NOT the :beads connection) is the only one consulted during compilation. Add missing indexes per §E.3 (cards(beads_status), taggings(card_id, tag_id), assignments(card_id, assignee_id)) if not already present.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/filter/translator_test.rb passes assertion: every operator emits SQL against the Fizzy primary connection only; a stub :beads connection that raises on any query is never invoked. Indexes verified via schema.rb diff.

title: S9 F.10 — Implement orphan cleanup hook (Beads 404 → OrphanCleanupJob)
description: Per spec §D.3, when a Beads issue is hard-deleted (mirror_issue receives 404 from Beads), enqueue OrphanCleanupJob.perform_later(issue_id). The actual destroy logic is Fizzy AR cascade per S7 §F.1.
design: In Beads::Mirror::Issue.call, rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound (or equivalent Beads-not-found signal) from the SELECT * FROM issues WHERE id=? :beads query. On 404: OrphanCleanupJob.perform_later(issue_id). Do not attempt to upsert the Card. Procedure remains idempotent: if Card no longer exists in Fizzy, OrphanCleanupJob is a no-op; if it still exists, the job removes it + cascades.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/beads/mirror/issue_test.rb passes new assertion: (a) when Beads returns no row for issue_id, OrphanCleanupJob is enqueued exactly once, (b) when Beads returns a row, OrphanCleanupJob is NOT enqueued, (c) replaying mirror_issue against a missing issue does not raise.

title: S9 F.9 — Implement single-board invariant correction in mirror_issue
description: Closes S2 placeholder fizzy-eq4.12. Per spec §D.2 + S2 §G.2, a card must have at most ONE fizzy/board/<uuid> label. The poller checks this on every mirror_issue tick and deterministically corrects violations via CommandClient.remove_label as the system actor.
design: Extend Beads::Mirror::Issue.call to inspect beads_issue.labels for entries starting with fizzy/board/. If size > 1: pick keep = most_recent_board_label_added(beads_issue.id, board_labels) (deterministic), then for each other label invoke CommandClient.for(SystemActor.identity).remove_label(beads_issue.id, label) per S5 _add_system_label / _remove_system_label semantics. The corrective write produces its own Beads event (next tick sees it; no infinite loop because correction is deterministic+idempotent).
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/beads/mirror/issue_test.rb passes new assertion: (a) issue with 2 board labels triggers exactly N-1 remove_label invocations on CommandClient, (b) the kept label is the one with the most recent label_added event, (c) issue with 0 or 1 board labels triggers no correction, (d) re-running mirror_issue post-correction produces no further calls (idempotent).

title: S9 F.8 — Implement BeadsResync periodic job (24h full resync)
description: Per spec §D.1, a separate recurring job runs nightly to catch any rows the event-cursor poller missed (cursor strategy can drop rows if Beads writes events out-of-order under load). Iterates ALL open Beads issues, applies mirror_issue + label diff + custom_statuses refresh.
design: Add app/jobs/beads_resync.rb extending ApplicationJob. perform iterates open Beads issues (SELECT * FROM issues WHERE status NOT IN closed_set via :beads), invokes Beads::Mirror::Issue.call(issue.id) for each (idempotent), diffs Beads labels(issue_id) against MySQL taggings(card_id) JOIN tags and applies missing add/remove via F.5 procedure, refreshes beads_custom_statuses (F.4). Register in config/recurring.yml at every 24h.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/jobs/beads_resync_test.rb passes: (a) re-running resync produces zero net changes when mirror is already in sync, (b) a manually-deleted Tagging is restored after a resync tick, (c) a manually-mutated cards.beads_status is corrected to match Beads source, (d) beads_custom_statuses table reflects current Beads custom_statuses contents.

title: S9 F.7 — Implement event mirror procedure (Event row creation per S8 §A)
description: Closes S8 placeholder fizzy-n3l.6. Per spec §C.5, after C.1-C.4 procedures complete for a Beads row, the canonical Event is mirrored via Event.create! using S8 EventMapper. Notifiable + WebhookDispatchJob fire via after_create_commit (intentional); touch_last_active_at is silent because Current.beads_mirror? is true (S8 §B.4).
design: Add Beads::Mirror::Event.call(beads_event, prior_snapshot:) in app/models/beads/mirror/. Invoke Beads::EventMapper.call(beads_event, prior_snapshot:) — returns nil for unmapped types (silently skip per S8 §A). Otherwise Event.create!(action:, eventable_type:, eventable_id:, board_id: resolve_board_at_time(card_id, beads_event.created_at), creator_id: ActorMapper.call(beads_event.actor), created_at: beads_event.created_at, particulars:, beads_event_id:). The unique index on events.beads_event_id (S8 §B.2) makes replay idempotent.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/beads/mirror/event_test.rb passes: (a) mapped event creates Event with beads_event_id set, (b) duplicate Beads event id raises uniqueness error and is silently swallowed (idempotent replay), (c) unmapped event types produce no Event row, (d) Notifiable + WebhookDispatchJob enqueue, (e) Card#touch_last_active_at is NOT invoked (mirror-mode guard).

title: S9 F.6 — Implement comment mirror procedure (comments + ActionText + mention enqueue)
description: Closes S6 placeholder fizzy-edq.11. Per spec §C.4, mirrors a Beads comment row through Comment upsert + ActionText cache + Search::Record sync + watch derivation + Mention::CreateJob enqueue.
design: Add Beads::Mirror::Comment.call(beads_comment) in app/models/beads/mirror/. Steps in order: (1) Comment.upsert_all([{id: bc.id, card_id: bc.issue_id, creator_id: ActorMapper.call(bc.author), created_at: bc.created_at, updated_at: bc.created_at}], unique_by: :id); (2) ActionText::RichText.upsert_all([{record_type: Comment, record_id: bc.id, name: body, body: PlaintextToActionTextHtml.call(bc.text)}], unique_by: [:record_type, :record_id, :name]); (3) Search::Record.upsert!(comment_attrs(bc)); (4) INSERT IGNORE on watches to ensure card.watched_by(creator); (5) Mention::CreateJob.perform_later(comment_id: bc.id, mentioner: comment.creator). Comments mirror MUST commit BEFORE the comment_created Event row (F.7).
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/beads/mirror/comment_test.rb passes: (a) Comment row exists with mapped creator_id, (b) ActionText::RichText body is the rendered HTML, (c) Search::Record upserted, (d) Watch row exists for creator, (e) Mention::CreateJob enqueued exactly once per call, (f) replaying same comment produces zero new rows + zero new enqueues.

title: S9 F.5 — Implement label delta procedure (tags+taggings upsert_all per S5)
description: Per spec §C.3, events with event_type IN (label_added, label_removed) drive tag/tagging upserts/deletes against the mirror per S5 §B.3. Labels failing LabelNormalizer are skipped per S5 §E.4 (CLI-only stance).
design: Add Beads::Mirror::Label.apply(event) in app/models/beads/mirror/. For label_added: Tag.upsert_all([{account_id:, title: LabelNormalizer.call(raw)}], unique_by: [:account_id, :title]); then Tagging.upsert_all([{card_id:, tag_id:}], unique_by: [:card_id, :tag_id]). For label_removed: Tagging.where(card_id:, tag_id:).delete_all. Skip rows where LabelNormalizer.call returns nil. All callback-bypass.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/beads/mirror/label_test.rb passes: (a) label_added creates Tag + Tagging rows, (b) label_added on existing tag does not duplicate, (c) label_removed deletes only the matching Tagging, (d) labels failing LabelNormalizer are silently skipped (no Tag created, no error).

title: S9 F.4 — Add beads_custom_statuses mirror table + refresh in periodic resync
description: S2 §B.2 requires custom_statuses categorization (done/frozen/unspecified) for column routing. Per spec §C.2 + §D.1, a small mirror table is refreshed by the nightly resync.
design: Migration creating beads_custom_statuses(name varchar(64) PK, category varchar(32) NOT NULL, updated_at datetime NOT NULL). Add app/models/beads/custom_status.rb. Refresh logic in BeadsResync (F.8): SELECT name, category FROM custom_statuses via :beads, then upsert_all on the mirror table. Low frequency — custom statuses change rarely.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate creates the table; bin/rails test test/models/beads/custom_status_test.rb passes refresh assertion: given a Beads custom_statuses fixture, calling the refresh procedure populates beads_custom_statuses with matching (name, category) rows, and re-running it is idempotent.

title: S9 F.3 — Implement mirror_issue procedure (cards + Search::Record sync)
description: Closes S4 placeholder fizzy-1iz. Per spec §C.1, this is the issue snapshot → cards mirror procedure invoked by every events row mirror and by periodic resync. Bypasses callbacks via upsert_all and explicitly invokes Search::Record.upsert! per §B.2.
design: Add Beads::Mirror::Issue.call(issue_id) (or equivalent in app/models/beads/mirror/) that SELECTs * FROM issues WHERE id=? via the :beads connection, then Card.upsert_all([{id:, beads_status:, closed_at:, defer_until:, close_reason:, title:, updated_at: Time.current}], unique_by: :id), then Search::Record.upsert!(card_attrs(beads_issue)) per shard (account-id-routed). All writes are callback-bypass per P9 §A.2. Procedure is idempotent on the same Beads row.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/models/beads/mirror/issue_test.rb passes assertions: (a) calling mirror_issue twice produces identical Card row (idempotency), (b) Card row reflects Beads issue beads_status / closed_at / defer_until / close_reason verbatim, (c) Search::Record row exists for the card with content sourced from card.title + beads_status + tag titles, (d) AR callbacks on Card are NOT invoked (no Card.touch_last_active_at side effect).

title: S9 F.2 — Implement BeadsPoller recurring job (30s tick, mirror-mode guard, single-engine)
description: Implements the single poller engine that drives all mirror procedures. Per spec §A.1 + §A.4, this is the one source of ordering: Solid Queue recurring job at 30s cadence, runs in Current.with(account: Account.singleton, actor: SystemActor.email) with Current.beads_mirror=true (S8 §B.4 guard).
design: Add app/jobs/beads_poller.rb extending ApplicationJob. perform method wraps Beads::Mirror::Cursor.advance_all in Current.with block setting account=Account.singleton, actor=SystemActor.email, beads_mirror=true. Register the job in config/recurring.yml at every 30s. Backpressure: if a tick processes a full batch < 5s, a follow-up tick fires immediately (backlog burndown). Single engine; NO parallel mirror workers in V1.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails test test/jobs/beads_poller_test.rb passes with assertions: (a) perform sets Current.beads_mirror=true inside the block and clears it after, (b) Current.account = Account.singleton and Current.actor = SystemActor identity for the duration, (c) advance_all is invoked exactly once per tick, (d) recurring entry exists in config/recurring.yml at 30s.

title: S9 F.1 — Add beads_mirror_cursors table (last_seen_at + processed_ids overlap window) + Beads::Mirror::Cursor model
description: Establishes the per-source cursor substrate the poller depends on. Per spec §A.2, Beads events.id and comments.id are MySQL uuid() v1 (timestamp-MAC, NOT monotonic), so the cursor MUST be timestamp-based with a processed_ids overlap window for dedupe.
design: New migration creating beads_mirror_cursors(source varchar pk, last_seen_at datetime(6), last_advanced_at datetime, processed_ids text). Add app/models/beads/mirror/cursor.rb implementing Beads::Mirror::Cursor with class method advance_all and instance methods to maintain the overlap window (overlap_seconds=2). Cursor advances ONLY after the per-row mirror procedure transaction commits. Discards processed_ids whose row created_at < new last_seen_at - overlap_seconds.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate creates the table; bin/rails test test/models/beads/mirror/cursor_test.rb passes assertions covering: (a) advance_all iterates each registered source independently, (b) processed_ids dedup catches a Beads row replayed in the overlap window, (c) sliding window discards stale ids when last_seen_at advances past overlap_seconds.

title: S9: Search + filter + poller spec
description: Ninth Spec round (S-batch). The big mirror-engine spec. Produces perfect beads for: (a) the Beads→Fizzy poller that ingests events/comments/issues snapshots and writes (callback-bypass) into MySQL mirror tables, (b) per-source mirror procedures coherently implementing S2/S4/S5/S6/S7/S8 contracts, (c) drift detection + reconciliation including single-board invariant correction, (d) filter compilation (no cross-DB joins), (e) 16-shard FTS execution. Closes 4 placeholders on lock: fizzy-1iz (S4), fizzy-eq4.12 (S2), fizzy-edq.11 (S6), fizzy-n3l.6 (S8). Inputs: P9 primary; all S2-S8 mirror contracts. Drafter: fizzy-claude (alternation). Output: llm/notes/s9-search-filter-poller-spec.md design doc + parent epic + child beads + dependency wiring.
design: Single poller engine with 30s tick interval. Event-cursor based ingestion (Beads events highwater + comments highwater). Callback-bypass upsert_all writes per P9 §A.2. Per-source mirror procedures: events→Event rows per S8 mapping; comments→comments mirror + ActionText cache + Event rows + mentions per S6+S8; labels→tags+taggings per S5; issues snapshots→cards.beads_status + closed_at + defer_until + close_reason per S4; custom_statuses→mirror table per S2. Drift detection: full periodic resync; single-board invariant correction; orphan attachment cleanup. Filter compilation: Fizzy filter UI → Card mirror SQL (no cross-DB joins). Search: 16-shard FTS routing.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc llm/notes/s9-search-filter-poller-spec.md complete with sections A-K per llm/notes/s9-brief.md; parent epic + child beads (~12-18); cross-spec deps to S1-S8 epics + their relevant children; 4 placeholders closed on lock (fizzy-1iz, fizzy-eq4.12, fizzy-edq.11, fizzy-n3l.6); ratified 3-of-3 by [S9: agreed] signals.

Closes 4 placeholders on lock: fizzy-1iz (S4 lifecycle mirror), fizzy-eq4.12 (S2 single-board drift), fizzy-edq.11 (S6 comments mirror), fizzy-n3l.6 (S8 events mirror). Build on locked S1-S8.

title: S8 F.5 — Make Card#touch_last_active_at callback-safe for poller-created Events
description: Event creation currently triggers eventable.event_was_created, which touches Card.last_active_at via update! (callbacks). Poller-created Events must not cascade callback-driven writes that violate the mirror doctrine.
design:
Avoid callback-driven writes for poller-originated Event creation.

Implementation decision: keep existing callback semantics for non-poller paths, and add an explicit mirror-mode context signal (e.g. Current.beads_mirror?). When mirror-mode is true, Card::Eventable#touch_last_active_at must use callback-bypass updates (update_columns/update_all). When mirror-mode is false, preserve current update! behavior.

Poller/mirror code must set mirror-mode around Event.create! (and other mirror writes) so last_active_at touches do not trigger downstream callbacks (Searchable/Mentions/etc) in mirror mode.
acceptance_criteria:
- Card::Eventable#touch_last_active_at no longer uses update!.
- Unit test asserts last_active_at updates without triggering Searchable callback side effects (or asserts no extra Search::Record writes occur).
- All existing tests pass.

title: S10 F.5 — Lint: forbid Filter predicates that depend on metadata JSON
description: Enforce the invariant: any field used in Filter predicates must be sidecar-indexable MySQL, not Beads metadata. Add a lightweight lint/test that fails if filter code references cards metadata JSON column or Beads metadata at request time.
design: Add a unit test over Filter compilation code that asserts generated SQL never references the cards metadata JSON column. Also add a simple grep-based assertion (or RuboCop custom cop if needed later) forbidding `metadata` access in Filter translator code.
acceptance_criteria:
- Test fails if Filter compilation references cards metadata JSON column.
- Test fails if Filter translator tries to query Beads at request time.

title: S6 F.10 — Unit tests: converters + CommandClient comment/description methods
description: WHY: The conversion boundary (ActionText↔plaintext) and CommandClient argv must be stable; unit tests prevent silent drift.
design: HOW: Add unit tests for ActionTextToPlaintext + PlaintextToActionTextHtml + CommandClient#add_comment/#update_description argv and JSON parse.
acceptance_criteria: - Unit tests pass\n- Covers multiline + escaping

title: S6 F.11 — S9 poller: mirror Beads comments→MySQL comments + ActionText + search + mention/watch
description: WHY: CLI writes bypass Fizzy controllers. Poller must mirror Beads comments into MySQL cache and derive mentions/watchers so UI stays correct.
design: HOW: In S9 poller, detect new/changed Beads comments. Callback-bypass upsert MySQL comments rows and action_text_rich_texts body using plaintext→HTML (F.5). Explicitly upsert Search::Record for comment content. Run watch_by for comment creator. Enqueue Mention::CreateJob for the comment (requires F.8).
acceptance_criteria: - Poller creates/updates Comment mirror from Beads\n- Search includes comment text\n- Mentions + watches created for CLI comments
close_reason: Superseded by fizzy-pmi.6 (S9 F.6 comment mirror procedure) which is the canonical implementation under the S9 poller engine. Implementation moves to fizzy-pmi.6.

title: S6 F.8 — Mentions: parse plaintext @tokens + create Mention rows (supports CLI comments)
description: WHY: Upstream mentions are ActionText attachment-based, but Beads stores plaintext. We need plaintext mention parsing so CLI-created comments can still generate mention notifications.
design: HOW: Update Mentions concern to scan mentionable_content plain text for @email and (optional) @handle tokens, resolve against mentionable users (board.users when present else account.users), and create Mention rows idempotently. Ensure poller schedules Mention::CreateJob for mirrored comments since poller bypasses callbacks.
acceptance_criteria: - Unit tests: @email creates mention; unknown user ignored; ambiguous handle ignored\n- Mention::CreateJob works on mirrored comment\n- No reliance on ActionText attachments

title: S6 F.9 — Integration tests: CommentsController#create (Beads write + derived cache)
description: WHY: Controller rewire is core UX. Need tests asserting Beads write is invoked, derived cache written, and forbidden paths blocked.
design: HOW: Add integration tests for Cards::CommentsController#create with CommandClient stub returning JSON (id/created_at). Assert Comment exists with id=beads id and ActionText body derived. Assert update/destroy return 405/403.
acceptance_criteria: - bin/rails test passes (scoped)\n- Fails without controller rewire

title: S6 F.6 — Rewire Cards::CommentsController#create to Beads + derived cache; disable update/destroy
description: WHY: Comments are canonical in Beads and append-only. Fizzy must stop writing MySQL comments as source-of-truth and instead write to Beads first, then populate derived cache for UI.
design: HOW: Update Cards::CommentsController#create: serialize ActionText→plaintext (F.4), call CommandClient.add_comment (F.2), then write derived Comment mirror row (id=beads id, created_at from JSON) + ActionText body derived from Beads plaintext (F.5). Remove/disable update/destroy routes or return 405/403; hide UI affordances.
acceptance_criteria:
- Creating comment writes to Beads (CommandClient invoked)
- Comment rendered immediately using derived cache
- Update/destroy are disallowed
- Existing system tests updated

title: S6 F.7 — Rewire CardsController#update description to Beads + derived ActionText cache
description: WHY: Card description is canonical in Beads issues.description. Fizzy must write edits to Beads and treat ActionText as derived cache.
design: HOW: Update CardsController#update for description changes: serialize ActionText→plaintext (F.4), call CommandClient.update_description (F.3), then update derived ActionText cache (F.5) so UI shows canonical. Ensure Search index updated explicitly if callback-bypassed.
acceptance_criteria: - Editing description triggers CommandClient bd update\n- UI reflects canonical plaintext rendering\n- Search index updated (or explicitly deferred to S9)

title: S6 F.4 — Implement ActionText→Beads plaintext serializer (Card.description + Comment.body)
description: WHY: UI inputs are ActionText; Beads stores plaintext. We need a deterministic serializer from ActionText HTML/content to Beads plaintext (preserve newlines, strip formatting, encode mentions).
design: HOW: Add helper Fizzy::Beads::ActionTextToPlaintext.call(value). Primary: ActionText::Content.new(value).to_plain_text. Ensure mention attachments (if present) serialize to @email tokens (best-effort) so Beads comment text can carry mentions.
acceptance_criteria: - Unit tests cover blank, multiline, stripping formatting\n- Mention attachment serialization to @email (if any)\n- No HTML tags leak

title: S6 F.5 — Implement Beads plaintext→ActionText HTML converter (derived cache)
description: WHY: Fizzy UI expects ActionText rich text for Card.description and Comment.body. Beads is plaintext SoT, so we need a stable converter for derived HTML cache.
design: HOW: Add helper Fizzy::Beads::PlaintextToActionTextHtml.call(plaintext) that escapes HTML and preserves paragraphs/newlines (simple_format-like). No attachments/embeds. Output is stored in action_text_rich_texts.body.
acceptance_criteria: - Unit tests cover escaping + newline handling\n- Deterministic output (idempotent for same input)

title: S6 F.2 — Add CommandClient#add_comment (bd comments add --author --file --json)
description: WHY: All comment writes must go to Beads (SoT). Fizzy needs a single safe wrapper that can add comments without quoting/escaping pitfalls and returns the Beads comment id for mirror writes.
design: HOW: Extend Fizzy::Beads::CommandClient with add_comment(issue_id, plaintext). Implement via tmp file + argv: ["comments", "add", issue_id, "--file", path, "--author", actor_email, "--json"]. Parse JSON output to struct/hash with id/created_at.
acceptance_criteria: - Unit test asserts argv + JSON parse\n- Handles multiline comment text\n- Raises CommandError on non-zero exit

title: S6 F.3 — Add CommandClient#update_description (bd update --body-file)
description: WHY: Beads issues.description is canonical. Fizzy must write description edits to Beads via CommandClient using stdin/body-file to avoid quoting pitfalls.
design: HOW: Extend CommandClient with update_description(issue_id, plaintext). Implement via tmp file + argv: ["update", issue_id, "--body-file", path] (or --description for short). Ensure actor flag is prepended by invoke!.
acceptance_criteria: - Unit test asserts argv\n- Handles multiline descriptions\n- Rejects empty description unless allow-empty configured

title: S6 F.1 — Migrate comments.id uuid→varchar(255) (use Beads comment id)
description: WHY: Beads comments.id is a UUID string (char(36)) and is canonical. Fizzy must mirror Beads comments with stable ids, so comments.id must accept Beads comment ids directly (S6 decision).
design: HOW: Write a Rails migration to change MySQL comments primary key type from uuid to varchar(255) with no backfill (V1 fresh installs). Ensure indexes on comments.card_id remain. Verify ActionText record_id widening already in place (S1 fizzy-jzw) so Comment.body rich text works with string ids.
acceptance_criteria:
- Migration runs on clean DB
- comments.id is varchar(255)
- Can create Comment with id=beads uuid string
- bin/rails test passes

title: S4 F.7 — Persist and restore metadata.fizzy.prior_status on close/defer
description: WHY: Reopen/undefer must restore the prior status (P6) instead of always returning to open.

acceptance_criteria: Close+reopen restores prior status; defer+undefer restores prior status; key schema matches S4 spec.
